This time [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com) writes the SQL. Copy each block
(use the copy button in its top right corner) and paste it into Gemini. Run
the blocks in order in the same chat: the table schema tells Gemini what your
table looks like, so it has to go first.

Then copy the query Gemini writes into the DoltHub SQL editor for your books
database and run it. Look at the result and check that it really answers the
question.

## Table schema

Paste this first. It shows the `books` table and its columns.

```sql
CREATE TABLE books (
  id int NOT NULL,
  title varchar(1023),
  author varchar(1023),
  year int,
  genre varchar(1023),
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
);
```

## Question 1

```default
Show the title and author of every Science Fiction book, sorted from oldest to newest.
```

## Question 2

```default
Show the title and year of every book published before 1900.
```

## Question 3

```default
Show the title and author of every book with the word "Habits" in its title.
```

## Question 4

```default
For each genre, show the genre and num_books, the number of books in that genre, sorted from most books to fewest.
```

## Question 5

```default
For each genre that has more than one book, show the genre and earliest_year, the year of the oldest book in that genre.
```

## Question 6

```default
Can you give me 5 more examples of natural language prompts and the corresponding SQL queries you would write for this database?
```
